detector_label_contract.negative_policy: zero semantic robot pixels; retain reason as outside image, fully occluded, or empty background

positive_requires_all.max_bottom_edge_gap: max(6 px, 0.15 times projected hull height)

detector_label_contract.target_semantics: visibly supported robot object, not a few-pixel or severely occluded sliver
detector_label_contract.threshold_change_rule: If the predeclared audit is infeasible, record failure and create a new protocol version before detector training; never tune thresholds on final_audit.

runtime_boundary.sliver_policy: A detector return may be recorded, but the later online hull/box gate must reject severe visible-support mismatch as a localization measurement.
